providers.NAME: ChatGPT
providers.COVERAGE: US: direct (OpenAI sign-up and cancellation emails), Google Play and iTunes, summed. Direct sends a sign-up email only (no renewals); a cancellation counts only after a sign-up.

providers.NAME: Claude
providers.COVERAGE: US: direct (Anthropic welcome and monthly payment emails, plan from the price), Google Play and iTunes, summed.

providers.NAME: Gemini
providers.COVERAGE: US: Google AI plans (AI Plus, AI Pro, AI Ultra) from Google One emails (direct), Google Play and iTunes, summed. Storage-only Google One plans are excluded; the 2026 same-price 2 TB to AI Plus rename counts as adds.

providers.NAME: Grok
providers.COVERAGE: US: SuperGrok, Heavy, Lite and X Premium+ on Google Play and iTunes. No direct sender from xAI or X Corp. Store cancellations of free trials with no paid receipt are not counted as churn.

providers.NAME: Perplexity
providers.COVERAGE: US: Google Play and iTunes only. Direct sends unpriced welcome emails, mostly free promotional Pro, which cannot be told apart from paid sign-ups; shown for reference but not counted.

providers.NAME: Muse
providers.COVERAGE: US: Power and Maximum on Google Play and iTunes from launch (2026-09-08), plus Muse Code (Meta direct welcome emails) as its own plan. Consumer web (Meta Pay) billing sends no receipt; see the Muse page.

methodology.TITLE: Gross adds, churn and net adds from sign-up and cancellation emails (US)
methodology.SOURCE: NIQ e-receipts, US SRS_SLICE.COMMON.ITEMS_V, mailboxes that joined before 2023 and are still active: the providers' direct senders (<provider> and <provider> Cancellation), Google Play / Google Play Cancellation and iTunes / iTunes Cancellation, filtered per provider in engine/email_flows.py.

FILTERS.RULE: Gross add = the first sign-up or paid subscription email in a series for a mailbox; a new series starts after a gap of more than 75 days (400 after an annual plan) or after a cancellation email
FILTERS.WHY: Google Play, iTunes and Anthropic send a receipt at every renewal; only the first in a run is a new subscription.

FILTERS.RULE: Churn = cancellation emails, counted only while the mailbox is subscribed (its previous add or cancellation for the provider, on any channel, is a gross add); emails within 45 days with no sign-up or payment between them are one cancellation
FILTERS.WHY: Google Play sends two or three emails per cancellation. No lapse modelling: churn is dated when the cancellation email arrives. Cancellations with no sign-up since the previous one (missed sign-up emails, free trials) are dropped.

FILTERS.RULE: Combined = the sum of direct + Google Play + iTunes for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Muse; Google Play + iTunes for Grok and Perplexity (no cross-channel de-duplication)
FILTERS.WHY: Grok has no direct sender. Perplexity direct is unpriced welcome emails, mostly free promotional Pro, that cannot be told apart from paid sign-ups.

FILTERS.RULE: Gemini covers Google AI plans; the 2026 rename of 2 TB to Google AI Plus (2 TB) at the same price counts as adds
FILTERS.WHY: 2 TB includes AI Plus; Yipit counts the rename too.

FILTERS.RULE: Grok = SuperGrok + X Premium+; Google Play X cancellations name no tier and count when the mailbox's last X receipt was Premium+

methodology.DEDUPE: Within a channel as above. No de-duplication across channels: Combined is the sum of the channels (tested 2026-10-26: under 1% of adds and churn, about 10% of Gemini adds; trends unchanged). Mailboxes are counted once per month per channel.
methodology.MEASURE: Monthly GROSS_ADDS, CHURN and NET_ADDS (= GROSS_ADDS - CHURN) by provider x channel, plan = all (provider level; SWITCH_IN / SWITCH_OUT are zero). The page's subscriber and share charts sum NET_ADDS from 2025-01 (no opening stock): net subscribers added since January 2025. Panel counts, not scaled to the US.
methodology.LAG: From 2025-01; the current month is month-to-date (PARTIAL), so it rises as the month fills. Emails are dated by order date, and NIQ fills in recent days over the following mornings.

methodology.TITLE: AI assistant app downloads and DAU (SensorTower)

FILTERS.RULE: Unified product keys: ChatGPT 64665f59b3ae2712001279ed, Claude 663279a2b3ae277df21f2bd0, Gemini 65c58645bd9b7e3bc33c81b4, Grok 676652c29ccf2a852260e663, Perplexity 64228bbd093a344fcebbb5bd, Muse 6aa0b99dd70c1a09e42dc613
FILTERS.WHY: Matched by key, never by name: 'ChatGPT' alone is 12 SensorTower products, mostly clones.
WW is SensorTower's worldwide row; summing countries would double count.

methodology.DEDUPE: iPhone and Android phone summed per app, country and day.
methodology.MEASURE: DOWNLOADS = estimated first-time downloads; DAU = estimated daily active users. Usage share = an app's value over the sum of the six apps for the same metric and country. Modelled vendor estimates, best read as trends.
methodology.LAG: Downloads run to about T-2 and DAU to T-3; the latest DAU day arrives as 0 and is treated as missing. TR7D only where all 7 days are present.

methodology.TITLE: App launch benchmark: downloads and DAU by day since launch (SensorTower)
methodology.SOURCE: SensorTower SENSORTOWER.COMMON.CORE for the six tracked apps.

FILTERS.RULE: Day 0 = first day with downloads in the country; window day 0 to 365
FILTERS.WHY: Each app's CORE history starts at its launch.
SensorTower's first Muse day, 2026-09-07, is a partial pre-launch day.

methodology.DEDUPE: Summed per app, country and day.
methodology.MEASURE: CUM_DOWNLOADS = running total from day 0; RETENTION = DAU / CUM_DOWNLOADS on the same day, a proxy (not cohort retention), compared across apps at the same day since launch.
methodology.LAG: Downloads about T-2, DAU about T-3.

methodology.TITLE: Engagement: app time spent, by day since launch and over the last 90 days (SensorTower)
methodology.SOURCE: SensorTower SENSORTOWER.COMMON.CORE sessions and minutes (cross-platform daily estimates).

FILTERS.RULE: Same apps, keys and day 0 as the launch benchmark
Zero sessions, minutes or DAU = missing

methodology.DEDUPE: iPhone and Android phone summed per app, country and day.
methodology.MEASURE: MIN_PER_SESSION = minutes / sessions; MIN_PER_DAU = minutes / DAU. *_TR7D ratios are 7-day sums over 7-day sums, over days where both values are present.
methodology.LAG: Sessions and minutes arrive about a week after DAU, so the last-90-days view ends earlier.

methodology.TITLE: Time spent: total minutes, sessions and users, app and web, by date and by day since launch
methodology.SOURCE: SensorTower SENSORTOWER.COMMON.CORE (minutes, sessions, DAU; iPhone + Android phone) and SimilarWeb SIMILARWEB.COMMON.VISITS_V2 (all_traffic_time_spent, all_traffic_visits).

FILTERS.RULE: Same apps and domains as App Data and Web traffic; US and WW
FILTERS.WHY: One series per provider and source.

FILTERS.RULE: Web is aligned on the app's day 0 for days since launch
FILTERS.WHY: Web has no launch date of its own; the app's first day with downloads is the common anchor.
Pre-launch muse.ai traffic is not Muse usage.

methodology.DEDUPE: One value per source, app, country and day.
methodology.MEASURE: Total daily time spent = minutes (app) or total minutes on site (web). Session count = app sessions or web visits. Time per session = minutes / sessions; its TR7D is 7-day minutes over 7-day sessions. Time per user = minutes / DAU (app only: SimilarWeb has no daily users), TR7D 7-day minutes over 7-day DAU. Share = an app's total over the six-app total that day, for totals only. A web visit is not an app session: compare apps within a source.
methodology.LAG: SensorTower time spent arrives about a week after DAU; SimilarWeb about T-3.

methodology.TITLE: Provider market share: daily gross adds, churn and net adds from sign-up and cancellation emails (US)
methodology.SOURCE: NIQ e-receipts, US SRS_SLICE.COMMON.ITEMS_V, mailboxes that joined before 2023 and are still active, classified by engine/email_flows.py (as the monthly gross adds).

FILTERS.RULE: Gross adds, churn and net adds as in the monthly email flows (churn only while subscribed), summed over each provider's combined channels
FILTERS.WHY: The same counts by day, so the daily, days-since-launch and monthly views agree.

FILTERS.RULE: Days since launch counts from the provider's US app day 0 (first day with downloads; Muse 2026-09-08), for its first 365 days
FILTERS.WHY: The same anchor as App Data, Web Data and Time Spent. ChatGPT, Claude and Grok sold subscriptions before their apps launched, so their gross adds start before day 0.

methodology.DEDUPE: Mailboxes are counted once per channel per day; no de-duplication across channels.
methodology.MEASURE: GROSS_ADDS, CHURN and NET_ADDS (= GROSS_ADDS - CHURN) per provider and day. Share = a provider's value over the sum across the six providers (net adds: over providers with positive net adds). % of panel = the value over PANEL, the number of mailboxes in the cohort (with or without an AI receipt). Panel counts, not scaled to the US.
methodology.LAG: Emails are dated by order date; NIQ fills in recent days over the following mornings, so the last few days rise.

methodology.TITLE: Web traffic: visits and minutes per visit (SimilarWeb)

FILTERS.RULE: Domains: ChatGPT chatgpt.com, Claude claude.ai, Gemini gemini.google.com, Grok grok.com, Perplexity perplexity.ai, Muse muse.ai; desktop plus mobile web, subdomains included
FILTERS.WHY: Each provider's web app; chatgpt.com includes chat.openai.com, which the pipeline sums into it.
Pre-launch muse.ai traffic is not Muse usage.

methodology.DEDUPE: One value per site, country and day.
methodology.MEASURE: VISITS = estimated visits. MIN_PER_VISIT_TR7D = 7-day time spent over 7-day visits. Time spent exists only for muse.ai, and for chatgpt.com and claude.ai from 2026-10-12; other sites show visits only. A SimilarWeb visit is not an app session: compare sites with each other.
